purpose: Build a fine-grained, interpretable component ledger of session-drift robustness on 18ch raw EEG, then test pre-declared feature subsets under the strict 20-fold subject-LOSO protocol. Final arbiter = Test S2-vs-S1 separation AUC of the E65 baseline (0.766024).

features.e65_cache_source: E65 per-trial per-band channel-standardized correlation logSPD (855 dims). Train cache from BrainPrint_cache/e65_correlation_spd with feature_manifest.json; Test cache is the E121/E122/E224 frozen Test logSPD.
features.bands_note: Same 5 bands as E36/E65 so that every block uses one common band definition.

corr_logspd.source: E65 cache (Train) / E121 cache (Test); recomputed from raw only inside the drift simulation and validated against the cache.

bandpower_gainfree.definition: log band power per channel per band (5 bands x 18 channels), minus that band's mean log power across the 18 channels of the same trial (removes per-band global gain/impedance drift).

spectral_shape.definition: per-channel log periodogram (1-40 Hz) demeaned along the frequency axis, then averaged inside each of the 5 bands (removes broadband 1/f level and gain).

spectral_slope.definition: per-channel least-squares slope of log power on log frequency over 1-40 Hz (1 value per channel).

pac.definition: per-channel alpha(8-13 Hz)-beta(13-30 Hz) phase-amplitude coupling, mean resultant length of beta amplitude modulated by alpha phase (Hilbert analytic signal).

trial_energy.definition: log RMS of the whole trial. Negative control: expected drift-sensitive and identity-poor.

drift_simulation.note: Every condition is applied to the raw waveform, then all blocks (including corr_logspd) are recomputed from the drifted waveform. No feature is ever perturbed in feature space.
drift_simulation.subset_rule: 20 evenly spaced trials inside the fit range (frac<=0.6) of each subject x task cell, deterministic.
drift_simulation.sensitivity_definition: per dimension: mean over conditions and over enrolled subjects of |f_drifted - f_clean|, divided by the between-subject standard deviation of that dimension on the fold's fit rows.

protocol.score_rule: score = -min euclidean distance to same-task prototypes (higher = known); reject if score < tau
protocol.tau_rule: global tau = 10% quantile of the inner 5-block OOF known scores of the fold's fit rows (E221/E224 rule, unchanged)
protocol.open_set_direction: high score = known; unknown is the positive class for rejection F1 and AUC(-score)

candidates.name: corr_only
candidates.note: E65/baseline reproduction anchor (not a new candidate).

candidates.name: all_blocks
candidates.note: All 1072 dims concatenated -> PCA96, k12. New baseline.

candidates.name: gainfree_only
candidates.note: corr_logspd + bandpower_gainfree + spectral_shape + spectral_slope + pac (no trial_energy).

candidates.name: low_drift
candidates.note: Drop dimensions whose drift sensitivity exceeds the 70th percentile of the fold's fit-row drift-sensitivity distribution.

candidates.name: high_disc_low_drift_96
candidates.note: Top 96 dims ranked by discriminability / drift sensitivity (fold fit rows only).

candidates.name: high_disc_low_drift_192
candidates.note: Top 192 dims of the same ranking.

candidates.name: random_96
candidates.note: Deterministic random dims, seed = config seed.

candidates.name: random_192
candidates.note: Deterministic random dims, seed = config seed + 1.

candidates.name: ledger_clean
candidates.note: Supplementary round (allowed once). Chosen from the round-1 ledger only: keep corr_logspd + bandpower_gainfree + spectral_shape + spectral_slope, drop pac (lowest discriminability and stability in the ledger) and trial_energy. No Test information used.

decision_rule.freeze: Test S2-vs-S1 separation AUC >= 0.80 AND LOSO AUC > 0.90

reference_e65_baseline.source: E221/E222/E223/E224 frozen baseline (E65 PCA96 k12, global tau)

selection: Every candidate and every parameter is fixed in this file before the run. Per-dimension rankings for low_drift / high_disc_low_drift are recomputed inside each fold from that fold's fit rows only. Test is read once, after all Train-side artefacts are frozen, and is used only for uniform evaluation.
official_note: Official Test AUC/F1 = N/A: Test has no identity labels.
